test_objective: Check that you can perform a partial update on a JSON property

test_cases.name: 012_08_01 Check that you can partially update a JSON property
test_cases.doc: Check that you can perform a partial update on a JSON property
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Partial Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: entityId set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: AttributeId set to 'jsonProperty' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'building-json-property-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
